status_definitions.validated: An authentic data product, or a direct geometric derivative of one (slope, profile) at a scale the data resolve, with a published accuracy assessment.
status_definitions.exploratory: Computed by MarsShield with a model that has not been tested against measurements in this region.
status_definitions.unavailable: Not offered here; the reason is stated.

raw_inputs.note: Olympus Mons caldera window at native resolution and a 1/8 overview of the volcano, read by HTTP range requests

regions.name: Gale Crater
regions.summary: Curiosity's radiation measurements and the terrain around Mount Sharp.

capabilities.name: Elevation, 3D terrain
capabilities.detail: USGS MSL Gale merged DEM, 1 m.

capabilities.name: Radiation measurements
capabilities.detail: Curiosity RAD Level 2 dose rates (NASA PDS/SPDF) at 322 stops.

capabilities.name: Sky blocked by terrain
capabilities.detail: Ray traced on the 1 m DEM; compared with Guo et al. (2026) at the parking positions, and differs at P6 (0.33 against 0.38).

capabilities.name: Radiation dose model
capabilities.detail: Tested retrospectively against RAD (322 stops, 8 parking periods). Its albedo share was derived from the same data, so this is not independent validation.

capabilities.name: Routes and where to stand
capabilities.detail: Planning illustration from the dose model; not validated for astronaut dose and not for operational use.

regions.name: Mars
regions.summary: Global elevation from the Mars Global Surveyor laser altimeter.

capabilities.name: Global elevation
capabilities.detail: MOLA gridded elevations at about 15 km per pixel; finer features are not resolved.

capabilities.name: Region outlines
capabilities.detail: Bounds of each regional dataset, from the regional manifests.

capabilities.name: Radiation
capabilities.detail: No global radiation map is offered; MarsShield's radiation analysis is local to Gale Crater.

regions.name: Jezero Crater
regions.summary: Perseverance's landing site and traverse on the USGS Mars 2020 CTX elevation model.

frame.note: x = R cos(lat_c) dlon, y = R dlat on the 3,396,190 m sphere; east-west scale error within +/-0.3 % across the region

capabilities.name: Elevation, 3D terrain
capabilities.detail: USGS CTX DTM, 20 m posts over 30 × 30 km.

capabilities.name: Slope
capabilities.detail: Over 20 m. Steps, boulders and scarps narrower than about 40 m are not resolved, so this cannot judge traversability.

capabilities.name: Elevation profiles
capabilities.detail: Sampled from the 60 m grid.

capabilities.name: Perseverance traverse
capabilities.detail: 708 localized waypoints, sols 13–2022; DTM minus rover elevation median -1.1 m.

capabilities.name: Sky blocked by terrain
capabilities.detail: Same definition as Gale, computed on the 60 m grid. Not tested against any measurement here; misses walls narrower than about 100 m.

capabilities.name: Radiation dose
capabilities.detail: Perseverance carries no cosmic-ray dosimeter, so no local measurement exists to test a model. Gale's RAD results are not transferred.

capabilities.name: Walking routes
capabilities.detail: The 20 m DTM cannot represent hazards at walking scale.

regions.name: Olympus Mons caldera
regions.summary: The summit caldera of the largest volcano on Mars, with the USGS geologic map of its six paterae.

frame.note: x = R cos(lat_c) dlon, y = R dlat on the 3,396,190 m sphere; east-west scale error within +/-0.6 % across the map

capabilities.name: Elevation, 3D caldera
capabilities.detail: HRSC/MOLA blend at 200 m posts over the 1:200,000 map area.

capabilities.name: Slope
capabilities.detail: Over 200 m only. Caldera walls that are 1–3 km high are steeper over shorter distances than this shows.

capabilities.name: Elevation profiles
capabilities.detail: Sampled from the 200 m grid.

capabilities.name: Geologic units
capabilities.detail: USGS SIM 3470 polygons (Mouginis-Mark, 2021), 1:200,000.

capabilities.name: Radiation dose
capabilities.detail: No surface radiation measurement exists here. Curiosity's RAD data belong to Gale and are not transferred; no model is offered.

capabilities.name: Sky blocked, routes
capabilities.detail: A 200 m grid cannot represent shielding or hazards at the scale of a person.
